description: This file defines the ImageThemeHooks class which implements theme hook functions for the Drupal image module, including preprocessing functions for image styles, previews, widgets, and anchors.

classes.name: ImageThemeHooks
classes.description: Implements theme hook functions for the Drupal image module, including preprocessing for image styles, previews, widgets, and anchors.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hook implementations for various image-related templates and elements.

methods.name: preprocessImageWidget
methods.description: Prepares variables for image widget templates, setting attributes and data.

methods.name: preprocessImageFormatter
methods.description: Prepares variables for image formatter templates, setting theme, URI, title, and size attributes.

methods.name: preprocessImageStylePreview
methods.description: Prepares variables for image style preview templates, including cache tokens and derivative images.

methods.name: preprocessImageAnchor
methods.description: Prepares variables for image anchor templates, organizing images into table rows.

methods.name: preprocessImageStyle
methods.description: Prepares variables for image style templates, applying image transformations and handling unsupported styles.
